amendment.after: the first publication of the frozen runner (all 70 seed-20260908 timing and 204 secondary records complete; compute.json, summary.json and findings.md written once)
amendment.execution: one additional launch of --score on 4 GPUs (one process each) for the seed-20260909/10 timing tasks; existing records are skipped, nothing is overwritten; PIDs in logs/score-pids.txt
amendment.status: post-hoc DESCRIPTIVE (phase-A review B0, 2026-10-16): the frozen seed-20260908 timing pass is restored as the confirmatory wall axis (wall columns, AUC x wall and top-3 x wall frontiers, the ICLR wall ratio, G1 over the frozen seed), equal to the first publication kept in superseded/; the three-seed wall columns, wall ratio, wall frontiers and all-seed reuse check are reported only under posthoc_wall and are not a confirmatory result
amendment.superseded: superseded/ keeps the first publication's findings.md, summary.json and compute.json
amendment.unchanged: cells, retained and secondary records, AUC and top-3, MACs, every MAC-axis frontier, bootstrap share and verdict, and the ICLR-sentence token (its rule uses MACs)
amendment.what: the timing pass was extended from the frozen seed 20260908 to all three seeds: 140 further timing records (seeds 20260909/10), new timing data collected after the freeze and after the first publication
amendment.why: judged after the first publication was seen: each seed is a separately trained policy, so seed 20260908 alone does not represent the all-seed MAC column of the same policy (grid transition calls per candidate at seed 20260908 vs pooled were 196 vs 121 for J-1e-04 and 21 vs 124.5 for CJ-1e-04), and the frozen seed-only J / C-J wall ratio of 16.7 describes seed 20260908

compute.hardware: 4 x RTX 5090 (one process per GPU) instead of the #85 RTX 3090

excluded.J-as-cont (#114): a counterfactual replay of J's recorded schedules; it needs J to run first, so it is not a deployable policy
excluded.OL-pe / OL-dec on the secondary set: their open-loop streams are frozen to the primary cell order and J's primary request frequencies (#101); no secondary analogue was frozen
excluded.wrong-anchor arms (#101/#114/#105): controls scored from the wrong anchor, not policies

primary.rule: 'matches a horizon-only adaptive baseline at a third of its compute' on the primary grid with the transferred ICLR operating recipe: J = J-1e-04 against the horizon-only adaptive C-J = CJ-1e-04. 'a third' holds iff J's MACs per candidate-state <= 0.4 x C-J's; 'matches' holds iff the paired J - C-J AUC lower bound > -0.02 (non-inferiority at delta). supported iff both; not_supported_by_this_experiment iff 'a third' fails or the upper bound < -0.02; else readiness_or_precision_insufficient; any failed guard -> readiness_or_precision_insufficient. The other J lambdas and the frontier status are reported DESCRIPTIVE. The same rule is reported on the secondary set (DESCRIPTIVE). If the primary token is not 'supported', a MANUSCRIPT ticket is opened (#103 acceptance).
